entities.name: Goblin Rocketeers
entities.description: Racing team of clever and daring goblins from an unknown plane that competed in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.description: Goblin co-captain of the Rocketeers who believes they achieved their mission to surpass the velocity barrier.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: Former planeswalker who bankrolled the team as unofficial co-captain, hoping for new interplanar travel after losing his spark.

entities.name: BOOSTGOD
entities.description: Deity of speed worshipped by the goblins, confined by a velocity limit.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: Race on Avishkar in which the Rocketeers competed.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where the Rocketeers arrived through a temporary Omenpath.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: Chaotic city on Avishkar around which the Grand Prix orbits.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: Region of the third leg of the race, where saurid raiders laid a trap.

entities.name: Saurid raiders
entities.description: Raiders who laid a trap on the course in Muraganda.

events.summary: The Rocketeers arrive on Avishkar via a temporary Omenpath after breaking the velocity barrier.
events.quote: Redshift and his crew effectively broke through an enforced speed boundary and traveled through a fleeting Omenpath, arriving safely on Avishkar.

events.summary: The Rocketeers abandon their exploration mission and, funded by Daretti, mount a campaign to win the Grand Prix.
events.quote: They abandoned their initial mission of exploration beyond the velocity limit.

events.summary: The Rocketeers lead the first three legs but are first to cross a trap laid by saurid raiders in Muraganda.
events.quote: they were the first to cross a trap laid on the course by saurid raiders

relations.quote: Redshift, who serves as the current co-captain of the Rocketeers
their adoptive benefactor and unofficial co-captain, Daretti
